title: DR1 calls the certification page "Additional details"; the frontend calls it "Additional animal details".

finding.frontend: The page heading is "Additional animal details" (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/additional-details/copy/copy.en.js:2), and the same words carry into the breadcrumb and the browser tab title. Below it the page asks two questions, both of which the two sides ask identically: what the animals are certified for, in sixteen radio options in the same order, and whether the consignment contains any unweaned animals.
finding.prototype: DR1's heading on the same page is "Additional details" (app/views/additional-animal-details.html:38), with "Commodity details" as the caption above it. The word "animal" is carried by the caption and the questions rather than by the heading.
finding.difference: Rename the page heading from "Additional animal details" to "Additional details" and follow the new name through the breadcrumb and the browser tab title, which both take the heading today. Check the hub task row that leads here at the same time. The heading is a whole-page name rather than a control, so this finding names no control and the report will show the whole page.
finding.falsifiedBy: Finding "Additional details" already used as this page's heading anywhere in the frontend.
finding.verification: Read both rendered DOMs (fe-additional-details.html:117 and dr1-additional-animal-details.html:253-254), both full-page screenshots, and both cited lines, which resolve exactly. Ran the falsifier as a grep for "Additional details" across the live-animals source: the only hit is an assertion message in a test file, never a heading. Also checked the sixteen certification options label by label on both sides — identical wording, identical order — which is what the frontend slot claims. CORRECT.
finding.correction: Nothing wrong with the claim. One addition to the difference slot's advice, recorded rather than written into the slot: the hub task row it tells you to check does exist and reads "Additional commodity details" (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/hub/copy/copy.en.js:43-45), so the frontend already carries two names for this page and DR1's rename makes a third unless the row moves with it. The check-answers card for the same content reads "Additional animal details" (check-answers/copy/copy.en.js:47) and needs the same treatment.
